title: eulophia amblyosepala
intro: Eulophia amblyosepala, commonly known as the Yellow Pendent Lip Orchid, is a flowering plant species belonging to the family Orchidaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate conditions such as skin infections and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Eulophia amblyosepala are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which may exhibit antioxidant, antiviral, and antiproliferative activities. However, more research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using Eulophia amblyosepala for medicinal purposes.
